description: Synthetic engineering fixtures, not real papers or scientific results. Retrieval regression only; not a benchmark of research quality.

documents.name: alignment.md
documents.text: Alignment protocol: visible thermal fusion requires image registration. Calibration reduces spatial offset between visible and infrared images. This fixture provides no accuracy numbers. 可见光与热红外融合需要图像配准，校准用于减少空间偏移。

documents.name: early-fusion.md
documents.text: Early fusion concatenates visible and thermal image channels before feature extraction. It requires aligned input images. It does not establish superiority under all conditions. 早期融合在特征提取前拼接图像通道。

documents.name: late-fusion.md
documents.text: Late fusion combines detector predictions after separate visible and infrared feature processing. It can combine confidence scores. Prediction fusion differs from early channel concatenation. 后期融合合并检测结果或置信度。

documents.name: evaluation.md
documents.text: Detection evaluation protocol: report mAP, precision and recall, specify the IoU threshold and dataset split. Comparing mAP across different splits or thresholds is not a controlled comparison. 检测评估应注明交并比阈值和数据划分。

documents.name: robustness.md
documents.text: Robustness checklist: evaluate low illumination, occlusion and sensor failure separately. Missing thermal frames require a fallback strategy. 夜间弱光、遮挡和传感器失效应分别评估。

documents.name: deployment.md
documents.text: Deployment checklist: report batch size, image resolution, hardware and latency distribution. Peak memory and throughput depend on configuration. Runtime speed cannot be compared without matching conditions. 部署应记录硬件、图像分辨率、批大小与延迟分布。
